description: Scans your transactions and finds money owed to you across employers, insurance, cards, HSA/FSA, travel protection and warranties.
notes: Demo transactions are seeded; real use needs bank/statement import.
Built against the shared Kit contract (window.Kit); a minimal inline shim is retained as fallback if shared/kit.js is ever absent.

notes.note: 'Free scan, pay on claim' with 15% of recovered funds is the perfect pricing for invisible money — zero trust barrier, pure upside. Employees leaving $1,000/yr unclaimed is a real, documented leak. The employer-distribution path (benefits teams love found money) is the scale story.
Transaction scan found $612.40; file-claim flow verified; zero errors. Fixed header overlap.
Normalized score schema: iteration-2 worker used thesis/magic_moment/demo_legibility/value_prop/ceiling; mapped to startup/originality/quality/usefulness/tech respectively.
